data.one_liner: Create and display Windows toast notifications.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to create and display custom toast notifications directly to the Windows operating system notification center. Supports initialization with AUMID and handling custom XML templates.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application targeting Windows.
You need native Windows toast notifications with custom XML and actions.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Windows, such as Android or iOS.
You need a cross-platform notification solution with a unified API.
strengths: Integrates natively with the Windows notification center.
Supports custom XML templates and action buttons.
weaknesses: Only supports the Windows operating system.
Requires platform-specific configuration like AUMID and MSIX setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires Windows-specific configuration including a unique AUMID and optional MSIX package configuration with a clsid.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a cross-platform notification plugin that supports multiple operating systems beyond just Windows.
